# Pixel Isolate — AI Background Remover & 8K Image Upscaler

> Pixel Isolate (pixelisolate.online) is a browser-based AI background remover and 8K Real-ESRGAN super-resolution upscaler built for Print-on-Demand (POD), e-commerce sellers, and digital designers. Background removal runs locally on-device via WebAssembly/WebGPU for complete privacy and zero white-halo edges on dark garments.

## Core Capabilities
- **AI Neural Segmentation**: Browser-based WebAssembly subject isolation preserving hair, fur, glassware, and delicate edges at full native resolution.
- **Subpixel HSV Chroma Keying & POD Halo Removal**: Interactive HSV color keying, BFS flood-fill protection for interior whites, and tunable morphological erosion/dilation/feathering sliders.
- **8K AI Image Upscaler**: Real-ESRGAN Vulkan super-resolution scaling Midjourney, Flux, and raster graphics to 4K & 8K (300 DPI) while preserving 32-bit RGBA alpha transparency.
- **Parallel Bulk Batch Processing**: Process 50+ images simultaneously and export transparent PNGs or pure white (#FFFFFF) / custom hex backdrops in a single ZIP archive.

## Pricing & Plans
Full details at [https://pixelisolate.online/pricing](https://pixelisolate.online/pricing):
- **Free Tier ($0)**: 10 free credits on signup, 3 HD trial exports, 1 solid backdrop trial — no credit card required.
- **100 Credit Bundle ($5 one-time)**: 100 non-expiring pay-as-you-go credits ($0.05/image) for full-resolution HD exports.
- **Pro Tier ($7.99/month)**: Unlimited background isolations, unlimited 4K & 8K AI upscaling, 50+ file bulk batch queue, custom solid hex backdrops, and AES-256 encrypted cloud History Gallery. Powered by Paddle (Merchant of Record) with a 14-day refund policy.
